summary: Federal Home Loan Bank of New York filed an 8-K reporting its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, as disclosed in a press release. The filing under Items 2.02 and 8.01 provides operating highlights: net income of $153.9 million, total assets of $176.7 billion, and advances of $110.5 billion. There is no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation event. The report is a routine quarterly earnings update with no structural or transactional changes. No advisors, recommendations, or deal terms are mentioned. No watch items or arbitrage angles apply because this is purely an operational and financial performance update.
